title: The Fastest, Safest PNG Decoder in the World
relevance: Wuffs PNG decoder decompresses zlib 'all-at-once' (full block Huffman then full block filter). Demonstrates the benefit of phase separation even without explicit pipelining.

title: GPU implementations of deflate encoding and decoding
relevance: GPU DEFLATE decoder using separate Huffman and LZ77 passes. Shows 1.66-8.33x speedup over multi-thread CPU decode and 4.13-36.56x over single-thread. Demonstrates viability of two-pass architecture.

title: Hardware Architectures for Lossless Compression
relevance: PhD thesis covering pipelined hardware architectures for Huffman and LZ77 processing. Provides detailed analysis of stage latencies and pipeline balancing for DEFLATE.
